name: lumora-icons-monorepo
description: Lumora — premium, abstract file & folder icons for VS Code and GitHub (Chrome).

scripts.package:vscode: npm run build:vscode && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('release',{recursive:true})" && cd extensions/vscode && vsce package --no-dependencies --out ../../release
scripts.package: npm run package:vscode && npm run package:chrome
